title: Prime Minister shares Sanskrit Subhashitam highlighting the importance of dedication to one’s duties
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi has shared a Sanskrit Subhashitam highlighting that those who remain devoted to their respective duties attain the highest perfection. He emphasised that those who diligently and sincerely perform their duties should understand how dedicated action can lead to the highest state of fulfilment. The Prime Minister shared a Sanskrit Subhashitam- “स्वे स्वे कर्मण्यभिरतः संसिद्धिं लभते नरः। स्वकर्मनिरतः सिद्धिं यथा विन्दति तच्छृणु॥” The Subhashitam conveys that those who remain devoted to their respective duties attain the highest perfection. Therefore, those who diligently perform their duties should learn how the highest state of perfection can be attained through dedicated and sincere action.
स्वे स्वे कर्मण्यभिरतः संसिद्धिं लभते नरः। स्वकर्मनिरतः सिद्धिं यथा विन्दति तच्छृणु।। pic.twitter.com/oiFIO7nmRv — Narendra Modi (@narendramodi) September 30, 2026
